title: Charles D Possible NDE
content:
I was 14 years old, and was down with a bad flu. As I lay on my bed, I started feeling tiny. I felt like my bedroom was the size of a large warehouse, compared to me. Then I was floating above my body, looking down at it curled on the bed. I started floating upward, and I could see the ceiling lamp from the side; like my eyes were exactly at the level of the ceiling. I could see the light bulb perfectly above the shade, and the graininess of the ceiling. This view was at an angle that I couldn't do physically because my head would have bump into the ceiling. My pupils were exactly on the ceiling surface. Then I was suddenly in my body again and no longer feeling tiny. I remember this event very clearly.

Since I was 17, I was diagnosed with a benign heart arrhythmia. Others in the family have it. However, whenever I get a flu, my heart beat goes way down sometimes very severely, like 30 bpm. This bradycardia also causes a severe sleep apnea causing me to stop breathing as soon as I fall asleep. This means a I have a night or two of insomnia. I believe my heart might have stopped for a while or gone into fibrillation when that OBE incident happened.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Illness Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening. Possible heart arrythmia
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: No I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness. I would say it was normal, as in a normal day, but more than just me with the flu.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was out of my body.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. It is hard to describe but things seemed to be a bit in slow motion.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Prior, I was in my bed, looking at the walls maybe. During the incident, I saw clearly my body and the ceiling.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Just a bit of curiosity I guess.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Catholic Catholic but not very practicing
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Well, I believed and still do that there is life after death, and the soul leaves the body at death. However, the event didn't last long enough for me to realize I might be dead.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: No changes in my life. I am more devout, but it is because of personal experience, not that possible NDE. However, I have actually dreamt my death in a very vivid manner very similar to an NDE. I don't claim it was an NDE, or even anything more than a dream. But after that experience, my fear of death diminished considerably. I find it meaningful.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I remember it very clearly. I practically remember nothing of what happened to me in life at the time.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I am convinced it was real.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Many years. I think I first related it to my wife. She didn't say yes or no.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real. Right after I didn't really think much of it. Later when I remembered it, I came to realize it seemed like I had left my body. When years later, I read about NDEs, Moody's book I think, I thought that something like that may have happened to me.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was probably real. I remember it so clearly, and what I saw was kind of unusual (the ceiling close up, my body etc.)
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It is kind of simple as NDEs go. I don't think I have anything to add.
